A cardiac and vascular surgeon specializes in surgical treatment of diseases affecting:

The heart
Arteries and veins
Blood circulation system
Chest organs related to cardiovascular function

featured_reviews.review_text:
A world-class heart surgeon who deserves more recognition!

My father recently had a CABG bypass surgery with Dr. Mahesh Singh and I could not have asked for better care. Unlike many surgeons who still rely on the older methods with leg veins, Dr. Mahesh Singh used LIMA, RIMA, and BIMA arterial grafts from the chest — far more durable and proven to give better long-term results. Very few doctors in India have the expertise and precision to do this successfully.

What truly sets him apart is his ability to perform bypass surgery even while the heart is still pumping — an advanced and highly demanding technique that ensures greater safety and accuracy.

Many patients are often directed to more “popular” surgeons based on name and reputation, without realizing that many of them still follow traditional techniques. Dr. Mahesh Singh, on the other hand, practices the latest advancements in cardiac surgery, giving patients safer operations, faster recovery, and outcomes that last.

Thanks to his advanced approach, my father's recovery was smooth and much quicker than expected — shorter hospital stay for by pass surgery related recovery, minimal complications, and a faster return to normal life.

Dr. Mahesh Singh may not be the most famous name in the field, but when it comes to skill, innovation, and genuine patient care, he is truly outstanding.
My father's post surgery recovery was good under his care and he made daily visits to check progress and advised further steps to full recovery.

He's a God sent angel!

Thank you once again from our heart ❤️

Another aspect we deeply appreciate is his accessibility. Cardiology consultations often involve long waiting periods for appointments, but Dr. Kahale makes every effort to accommodate patients whenever genuinely required, even allowing walk-in consultations when the situation demands urgent attention. This level of responsiveness provides immense reassurance to families dealing with cardiac concerns.

It has now been over two months since her discharge on 7th January, and under his continued follow-up care, my mother is doing significantly better & her diabetes which in 8 years wasn't controlled is controlled now.

Dr. Kahale is not just an outstanding cardiologist — he is compassionate, ethical, deeply knowledgeable, and incredibly reassuring for both patient and family. In a time filled with anxiety and difficult decisions, he gave us confidence, clarity, and hope.

Words truly feel inadequate to express our gratitude. He has been nothing short of a lifesaver for our family.

I would wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking cardiac care & diabetes . You are truly in the safest possible hands.
